On Thu, Sep 22, 2011 at 4:07 PM, Peng Yu <peng...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,
>
> This pie chart on the following link looks very complex. I'm wondering if
> there is a way to produce such a plot with ggplot2 or R?

It looks like a fancy treemap (maybe Voronoi Treemap) . Basic treemaps
can be created in R using the treemap package, or using the
gvisTreeMap function in the googleVis package, but I'm not aware of
any easy way to reproduce the NYT graph.

It looks like Hadley is actively working on a ggplot-based approach.
See http://vita.had.co.nz/papers/prodplots.html

Best,
Ista
